article.headline: Early Snow Falls in California's Sierra Nevada Mountains
bodyParagraphs: NASA reported that one of the first major snowfalls of the water year arrived in California's Sierra Nevada on November 13, 2026. The agency's Terra satellite captured fresh snow covering the mountains on the morning of November 14. Just two days earlier, the same peaks appeared mostly bare in satellite images. The MODIS instrument on the Terra spacecraft took these detailed pictures from space. According to the Central Sierra Snow Laboratory, about 30 centimeters of snow fell at Donner Pass during the storm. The National Weather Service also issued a warning for additional mountain snow from November 18 through 20. This early snowfall marks the start of the seasonal snowpack that helps supply water to the region later in the year.

article.headline: NASA Checks Voyager 1 Signal as Probe Remains Far Away
bodyParagraphs: NASA says Voyager 1 is still sending a carrier signal but has stopped transmitting science and engineering data. The problem was first noticed on November 14, and engineers are now investigating the cause. Because the spacecraft is extremely far from Earth, a radio wave takes about 24 hours to reach it, and any reply takes another 24 hours to return. This long delay makes the diagnosis very slow and difficult. NASA plans to use the carrier signal and trajectory calculations on November 19 to confirm the one-light-day distance. Officials warn that fixing the issue may take weeks or even longer.

article.headline: Early Snow Falls on Sierra Nevada Mountains
bodyParagraphs: NASA reported that an early-season storm brought snow to California's Sierra Nevada on November 13, 2026. The agency's Terra satellite recorded fresh snow covering the mountains on November 14. Just two days earlier, the same peaks appeared mostly bare in satellite images. The MODIS instrument on Terra captured this rapid change. About 30 centimeters of snow fell at Donner Pass on November 13, according to the Central Sierra Snow Laboratory. The National Weather Service also issued a warning for more mountain snow during November 18 to 20. This early snowfall marks the start of the water year for the region.
